title: Catch leprechauns dreams in crimson nets above Leprechaun Village
name: Catch leprechauns dreams in crimson nets above Leprechaun Village
description: The Rainbow Sentinel can catch leprechauns dreams in crimson nets above Leprechaun Village. The Sentinel works it under the Absolute Light-Angle Mandate, bending all gloom into harmless light at 42 and 51 degrees - a Signature tale, not a real device.
